meta_description: Alan Deakin Plastering delivers expert internal and external plastering across Birmingham. Free quotes, reliable finish. Call 07831 417279 today.
hero_eyebrow: Experienced Plasterer — Fast, Clean, Professional Finish
hero_subhead: From patch repairs to full internal and external replastering, we deliver a flawless finish on time, every time.
services_subhead: We handle everything from small domestic repairs to large commercial projects, with meticulous attention to preparation and finish.

services.title: Internal Plastering
services.desc: Full wall and ceiling plastering for new builds and renovations. We prepare surfaces properly and apply smooth, durable finishes ready for decoration.

services.title: External Rendering
services.desc: Weather-resistant external renders and finishes that protect your property and enhance curb appeal. We work in all seasons using quality materials.

services.title: Patch & Repair Work
services.desc: Quick repairs to damaged plaster, patching cracks, and making good around pipes and fittings. Small jobs completed same day where possible.

services.title: Skimming & Re-plastering
services.desc: Tired walls refreshed with professional skimming and re-plastering. We transform uneven or damaged surfaces into smooth, paintable walls.

services.title: Artex Removal & Replacement
services.desc: Safe Artex removal and replacement with modern plaster finishes. We work carefully to minimise dust and disruption to your home.

services.title: Commercial & Industrial
services.desc: Large-scale plastering for offices, factories, and retail spaces. We work flexibly around your business hours and deliver on schedule.

about_pullquote: A properly prepared surface and honest pricing — that's how I run this business.
about_para_1: Alan Deakin set up his plastering business in Birmingham over 18 years ago, built on the simple principle that good preparation and clean workmanship make all the difference. Since then, he's tackled everything from listed building restoration to new-build houses and commercial refurbishment, earning a loyal following across the city and surrounding areas.
about_para_2: Customers return to us because we turn up on time, protect your property, and leave no mess behind. Every job is treated with the same care, whether it's a small patch or a full house replaster. We're not the cheapest, but we're fair, and the finish speaks for itself.
reviews_heading: What Birmingham Homeowners Say About Alan

reviews.text: Had Alan in to skim our lounge and hallway. He prepared everything properly, worked cleanly, and the finish is perfect. No mess left behind. Would absolutely use him again.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Called Alan for an emergency patch after water damage. He came out quickly, assessed it properly, and did a brilliant repair that you'd never know was there. Very fair price too.
reviews.author: Michelle B.

reviews.text: Full external render on our 1970s bungalow. Alan was professional from quote to finish. He explained everything, protected the garden, and the render looks fantastic. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Robert H.
